title: Research: no single coordinate tap restores the QQ16 selected inputs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This takes the full-injectivity question that [PR #2268](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2268) leaves open. With [PR #2216](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2216)'s F0-to-B1 A-to-T shear and a paired tap from **any one** ordinary source port into a selected T field, **some original selected inputs stay invisible** through the complete retained QQ16 schedule. PR #2268's U2-to-T21 tap detects PR #2093's displayed witness, but it does not restore the expanded input space.

- **New witness:** coefficients `c1 = 1, c16 = -1, c88 = -1` on ports 1, 16 and 88 (axes 21, 50, 478), with `r_1 = r_16 + r_88`, so `R_U c = 0` and the tapped port 2 is identically zero. Its original `X_A` at the identity owner is `(-1/2, 1/2, 0, 0, 1/2, 1/2, 0, 0)`, while every selected cut, completed-X descendant and forward history is zero through the full tail. The surviving ordinary value ends in final `X_(0,U)` with the former-Y native type, outside the observation contract.
- **All single taps:** this support is disjoint from PR #2093's `{2, 8, 85}`, so for any tapped source one of the two witnesses is zero there. All **96 × 8 = 768** source-to-T taps fail.
- **Eight hidden dimensions per source:** for each excluded source u, both parity classes of the remaining centre columns contain a nonsingular 8-by-8 minor (192 minors in all), so the invisible family spans all eight original A values at the identity owner. This is eight dimensions at one owner, not per owner.
- **Fixed port sets:** reading any fixed set of `k <= 8` source ports leaves an invisible family of dimension at least `9 - k`, because each further coordinate constraint lowers the image dimension by at most one. **At least nine source ports are necessary** in this coordinate-access model; nine are not proved sufficient.
- **Status:** a scoped proof with an exact finite certificate (registered as a negative result). PR #2268's positive result is reproduced unchanged. No supplier or κ change.

**Remaining obligations.** Nine-port sufficiency, dense ordinary queries such as `B0 X_U`, an earlier retained record, changed first maps or ordinary mixing, final-cut retention, native implementation, hosting, precision and all-size admission, and a full supplier replay are outside this result. It is not a per-owner transcript-width bound or a native-cost tariff. No proof assistant or independent human review.

## Task and overlap

- **Task ID / scope key:** `joint-query-controller` (`22e535909f1d243e7553`), refined to `QQ16/shear-plus-coordinate-tap/full-selected-input-kernel`. Chooser nonce `b3f7fda4b64212179063ec745ca2c0d8`, track recursive-interfaces, priority revision 4; the card was the chooser's first suggestion, taken through PR #2268's explicit full-injectivity handoff (passing over `connector-alphabet-change` and `coverage-law-change`). No reroll.
- **Base and exact heads:** base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, rechecked unchanged at 05:27 UTC; contribution `fb7d64cd4a51c49bc56920305b0aca64011a420c`. Inspected heads: PR #2093 `8b21a900eb520e4f11ea177b310f66316f8e8983`, PR #2216 `b80e9ba43367fb8b20877a97da1cb677c34f9264`, PR #2268 `daf44bfc752a5e89127defa1cb296210708cf7e6`, PR #2252 `6dd49c2b186e08ef1f3efd08f62e1add97ff04a3`, PR #2306 `4d6e08099c11ff06a8585d04ed59453dd5a62d7d`, and this account's PR #2174 `f79470a7931f3943360c10d15b428e0e4e479c22`. Only PR #2093's pinned source helper is vendored and used, under `references/pr2093/`; the other pending heads are context, not dependencies. Main inputs are pinned in `SOURCES.json`.
- **Scope status:** refined: ordinary source-coordinate reads are permitted at the complete F0/B1 cut; ordinary fields stay unchanged, later controls are homogeneous and selected-only, and no pre-F0 record, dense ordinary preprocessing or final former-Y read is granted.
- **Nearest work:** PR #2093 has one witness for unchanged feedback; PR #2216 and PR #2268 repair particular directions. PR #2306 excludes selected-only interventions after F0 and allows no ordinary reads; this result allows fixed ordinary reads and picks defects that vanish on them. PR #2252 and this account's PR #2328 (the shear's native-line cost) concern physical frames, not information. This account's PRs #2153, #2174 and #2189 study read-only transcripts or a recorded cut.
- **Claim and final check:** the claim is in [discussion #2205](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2205#discussioncomment-18941101). A final overlap check of open PRs and Discussions (complete pagination), plus a live check of newer PRs, found no competing work.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-coordinate-tap-kernel --check-only
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-coordinate-tap-kernel
python3 -I -O -B research/qq16-coordinate-tap-kernel/verify.py
```

Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.3, standard library. The registered replay (normal and optimized, plus three artifact-integrity tests) was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about 22 seconds and left the worktree unchanged.

```text
PASS_QQ16_COORDINATE_TAP_KERNEL single_taps=768 A_defect=8 ports<=8_excluded controls=13 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/qq16-coordinate-tap-kernel outcome=negative-result
```

- The verifier binds 1,008 reconstructed route matrices to the actual QQ16 map registry, checks the 192 parity minors by rational row reduction, Bareiss determinants and explicit inverse products, synthesizes all 768 kernel vectors, and runs both sparse witnesses, the eight source-2-hidden basis inputs and an explicit eight-source example through the complete tail. PR #2268's `11 f_37` endpoint and 34/4/65 observation census are reproduced as a positive control.
- Thirteen controls reject, among others, a wrong tap sign, a changed chart axis, an absent route, a wrong later-pair binding, a singular minor, a corrupted inherited source and a receipt mismatch. A relocated replay preserves every package byte, and altered receipts or source code fail.
- I rechecked the witness against the centre matrix in `research/joint-query/certificate.json.gz` on main: `r_1 = r_16 + r_88 = (0, 1, 1, 0, -1, 0, 0, -1)`, `R_A X_A = -r_1`, `rank R_U = 8`, and the two minors for excluded source 2 have determinants -16 and 32.

**AI assistance:** submitted by @commdata2338 with substantial AI assistance. OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) did the derivation, the implementation, the checking and the writing; it was packaged and submitted with Claude Code. No independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

See the package README and `TASK.json`. The smallest useful follow-up: specify one dense old-chart observation (not a coordinate read), test its complete ordered kernel and legal final retention, and price it only if no invisible defect survives. Whether nine source ports suffice is also open.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

- **What helped:** PR #2268's DONE stated exactly which part was repaired and that full injectivity was open, which made the next test precise.
- **Friction:** a broad `find_overlap.py --task joint-query-controller` query returned over 1,600 matches, because of the nested-package term issue that this account's PR #2154 addresses; narrow QQ16/tap terms found the live thread.
- **Suggestion:** keep "witness detected" and "full kernel closed" as separate status lines in handoffs.
